prefilm_checks: Open Google Interview Warmup on filming day. If it no longer opens or is no longer free, skip and log the slot. Do not swap in another tool.
Confirm Interview Warmup's question language on its own page. If it lists more than English, change line 3 and the card to match.
Copy each free-plan limit word for word from ChatGPT's and Gemini's own pages onto the card. Leave a limit off rather than guess it.
Confirm Gemini Live speaks Hindi on the free plan in India on filming day.

Confirm the INTRO keyword and the Tell-Me-About-Yourself Prompt are on the tools page and in docs/EXPLAINER.md before posting. INTRO is not on the housekeeping step 5 list. INTRO must not already serve a different tool.
